title: Autonomous Forking
description: Autonomous Forking is a evolution ability in the Autonomous Evolutionary Forks database. Forks the running system into an isolated copy on its own decision. Forks trigger on schedule or stagnation; the copy starts from a checkpoint. It takes system and produces fork. Tunable parameters: checkpointed. Guarantee: forks never share mutable state.

fields.mechanism: Forks trigger on schedule or stagnation; the copy starts from a checkpoint.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Mutation Operators
description: Mutation Operators is a evolution ability in the Autonomous Evolutionary Forks database. Mutates forks with small random changes to parameters and structure. Operators tweak numbers, swap modules, and reorder steps within bounds. It takes fork and produces mutant. Tunable parameters: bounded. Guarantee: mutations never exceed declared bounds.

fields.mechanism: Operators tweak numbers, swap modules, and reorder steps within bounds.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Fitness Functions
description: Fitness Functions is a evolution ability in the Autonomous Evolutionary Forks database. Scores each fork by a declared fitness function. Fitness measures the goal — speed, accuracy, efficiency — on a fixed test set. It takes forks and produces scores. Tunable parameters: per fork. Guarantee: fitness is always measured, never guessed.

fields.mechanism: Fitness measures the goal — speed, accuracy, efficiency — on a fixed test set.
fields.guarantees: fitness is always measured, never guessed

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Tournament Selection
description: Tournament Selection is a evolution ability in the Autonomous Evolutionary Forks database. Keeps winners through tournaments between forks. Forks compete pairwise on fitness; losers are retired and winners reproduce. It takes population and produces survivors. Tunable parameters: pairwise. Guarantee: tournaments never compare different test sets.

fields.mechanism: Forks compete pairwise on fitness; losers are retired and winners reproduce.
fields.guarantees: tournaments never compare different test sets

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Elitism
description: Elitism is a evolution ability in the Autonomous Evolutionary Forks database. Always keeps the best fork ever seen. The all-time best is preserved untouched while the rest evolve. It takes history and produces elite. Tunable parameters: 1 kept. Guarantee: the elite is never mutated.

fields.mechanism: The all-time best is preserved untouched while the rest evolve.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Crossover
description: Crossover is a evolution ability in the Autonomous Evolutionary Forks database. Breeds new forks by combining two parents' traits. Traits are picked per-module from either parent; the child is validated. It takes parents and produces child. Tunable parameters: per module. Guarantee: children are always validated.

fields.mechanism: Traits are picked per-module from either parent; the child is validated.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Speciation
description: Speciation is a evolution ability in the Autonomous Evolutionary Forks database. Keeps diverse strategies alive in separate species. Forks cluster by behavior; selection happens within species to protect novelty. It takes population and produces species. Tunable parameters: clustered. Guarantee: novel species are never culled early.

fields.mechanism: Forks cluster by behavior; selection happens within species to protect novelty.
fields.guarantees: novel species are never culled early

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Stagnation Detection
description: Stagnation Detection is a evolution ability in the Autonomous Evolutionary Forks database. Detects when evolution stops improving and changes strategy. No fitness gain for N generations triggers new operators or a restart. It takes history and produces signal. Tunable parameters: N=20. Guarantee: stagnation never goes unnoticed.

fields.mechanism: No fitness gain for N generations triggers new operators or a restart.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Safe Sandboxing
description: Safe Sandboxing is a evolution ability in the Autonomous Evolutionary Forks database. Runs every fork in a sandbox that cannot touch the real system. Forks get virtual resources and no network; escapes are impossible by design. It takes fork and produces sandbox. Tunable parameters: isolated. Guarantee: a fork never affects production.

fields.mechanism: Forks get virtual resources and no network; escapes are impossible by design.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Human Veto
description: Human Veto is a evolution ability in the Autonomous Evolutionary Forks database. Lets a human veto any fork before it deploys. Winning forks queue for approval with their fitness evidence; veto is one click. It takes winners and produces approval. Tunable parameters: per fork. Guarantee: nothing deploys without approval.

fields.mechanism: Winning forks queue for approval with their fitness evidence; veto is one click.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Lineage Tracking
description: Lineage Tracking is a evolution ability in the Autonomous Evolutionary Forks database. Tracks every fork's ancestry back to the original. Each fork records its parents and mutations; the tree is browsable. It takes forks and produces tree. Tunable parameters: per fork. Guarantee: lineage is never lost.

fields.mechanism: Each fork records its parents and mutations; the tree is browsable.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Diversity Metrics
description: Diversity Metrics is a evolution ability in the Autonomous Evolutionary Forks database. Measures population diversity to avoid premature convergence. Diversity is the mean behavioral distance; low diversity boosts mutation. It takes population and produces metric. Tunable parameters: per generation. Guarantee: metrics are always computed.

fields.mechanism: Diversity is the mean behavioral distance; low diversity boosts mutation.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Multi-Objective Evolution
description: Multi-Objective Evolution is a evolution ability in the Autonomous Evolutionary Forks database. Evolves toward several goals at once with Pareto fronts. Forks are ranked by dominance across objectives; the front is kept. It takes objectives and produces front. Tunable parameters: Pareto. Guarantee: no objective is ever silently dropped.

fields.mechanism: Forks are ranked by dominance across objectives; the front is kept.
fields.guarantees: no objective is ever silently dropped

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Evolution Reports
description: Evolution Reports is a evolution ability in the Autonomous Evolutionary Forks database. Reports each generation in plain language. Reports cover the winner, its fitness, and what changed. It takes generations and produces reports. Tunable parameters: per generation. Guarantee: reports never hide regressions.

fields.mechanism: Reports cover the winner, its fitness, and what changed.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Rollback to Ancestor
description: Rollback to Ancestor is a evolution ability in the Autonomous Evolutionary Forks database. Rolls a fork back to any ancestor instantly. Checkpoints per generation make rollback one action. It takes fork and produces ancestor. Tunable parameters: 1 action. Guarantee: rollback never loses the failed fork's data.

fields.mechanism: Checkpoints per generation make rollback one action.
fields.guarantees: rollback never loses the failed fork's data

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.
